aliases: スマートレンディング
summary: Smart Lending is a Japanese crypto-asset lending service whose current first-party terms describe unsecured consumption-loan contracts with fixed lending periods and stated annualized interest rates.
what_happened: Current first-party materials identify Smart Lending Co., Ltd. as operator and describe 30-day ordinary and 365-day premium crypto lending. The terms state that ownership of lent crypto transfers to the company, lent assets are outside statutory segregated management, and repayment may fail if the company becomes insolvent.
uncertainty_notes: The exact original service-launch date is unresolved. Advertised 11%/13% annualized rates, yield-source explanations and reserve/return-preparation statements are operator claims and are not independently verified realized returns, proof of sustainability, reserves or solvency.
notes: Promotion follows duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000148 and candidate PR #339. No GEMFOREX or IZAKA-YA affiliation is asserted; relationship claims remain separately bounded under Issue #337.
